title: process.env is empty in a Cloudflare Worker while env.MY_VAR works inside fetch
symptoms: process.env.API_KEY is undefined in a deployed Worker
Libraries that read process.env at import time get no config
cause: Workers expose vars and secrets through the env argument, and process.env is only filled when nodejs_compat is on and the compatibility date is 2025-04-01 or later. Module scope code has no env argument at all.
fix: Read env from the handler, or import env from cloudflare:workers for module scope access. For libraries that need process.env, enable nodejs_compat with a date of 2025-04-01 or later.
affected: Cloudflare Workers, process.env population default on for compatibility_date 2025-04-01 or later with nodejs_compat
